table.retrieve:
SELECT
	SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode,
	HeaderInvNo=S.HeaderInvNo,
	HeaderNo=S.HeaderNo, 
	Date=S.Date,
	AliasName=A.AliasName,
	AccountName=A.Name,
	InvTotal=ISNULL(S.InvTotal, 0),
	OldAmt=ISNULL(S.Amt, 0),
	Amt=ISNULL(S.Amt, 0),
	PaymentMode=S.PaymentMode,
	PaymentAccCode=S.PaymentAccCode,
	ddd_AccCode=(SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = S.PaymentAccCode),
	AmtDate=S.AmtDate,
	AmtReference=S.AmtReference,
	AmtBy=S.AmtBy,
	OutStandingAmt=S.OutStandingAmt,
	Posted=S.Posted
	
FROM SaleLedger S, Accounts A
WHERE
	S.AccountFor = 'Y' AND 
	S.Deleted='N' AND
	S.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	S.Date >= :ad_startdate AND S.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
	S.HeaderNo = :ai_headerno
ORDER BY
	S.SaleInvCode,
	A.Name,
	A.AliasName
